entries.oldApproach: Provider-facing production tool schemas fell back to empty-argument functions or incomplete argument lists.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: The backend Zod schemas and tool implementations were correct, so the missing provider projection looked like plumbing rather than product behavior.
entries.whatFailed: Fresh-room public asks produced missing-argument tool calls such as search_sheet_context without query and capture_source without goal.
entries.newApproach: Production provider JSON schemas expose all canonical top-level Zod fields and required provider arguments, with parity regression coverage.

entries.oldApproach: Free OpenRouter routes were allowed to receive room context until the egress policy blocked uploaded-file data at runtime.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: Free routes are useful for cheap benchmark discovery and normally handle text-only public asks.
entries.whatFailed: Fresh uploaded-file tasks repeatedly failed with provider_egress_blocked:free_file_egress_requires_OPENROUTER_FREE_ALLOW_FILE_EGRESS.
entries.newApproach: Uploaded-file public asks keep the egress guard, but route-promote to AGENT_FILE_EGRESS_MODEL before queuing or running the slice.

entries.oldApproach: Benchmark runs used the same small per-slice step and spend ceilings as ordinary public asks.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: Small caps protect public rooms from runaway jobs and unexpected cost.
entries.whatFailed: Official benchmark tasks paused prematurely before gathering enough runtime/cost/capability data.
entries.newApproach: Benchmark jobs carry a benchmark_completion runtime profile through job rows, claims, journals, and browser tests.

entries.oldApproach: Uploaded workbook artifacts rendered through a separate Excel-paper UI path with green evidence styling and misaligned workbook chrome.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: Uploaded Excel files looked distinct from room-authored Sheet 1 artifacts and seemed to need a viewer-specific shell.
entries.whatFailed: The product had two sheet UIs to maintain, and the uploaded artifact did not match the canonical Sheet 1 work surface the agent writes into.
entries.newApproach: Uploaded workbooks and blank sheets both render through the shared r-sheet work-surface grid with workbook merge support and no false Excel-paper shell.

entries.oldApproach: Invalid model tool calls returned unclassified invalid-arguments blobs.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: The runtime already fed the error back as a tool result, so the model could theoretically recover.
entries.whatFailed: Missing required arguments were not classified as recoverable inputs and traces could not distinguish schema failure from generic tool failure.
entries.newApproach: Invalid tool arguments return structured tool_argument_error results with failureKind, missingRequiredArgs, and retry instructions.

entries.oldApproach: SpreadsheetBench live-browser proof used a bespoke receipt at docs/eval/spreadsheetbench-live-room-proof.json.
entries.whyItSeemedRight: SpreadsheetBench was the first official benchmark path proven through the live UI.
entries.whatFailed: The one-off shape could not scale to BTB, mobile, collaboration, failure, visual-judge, cost, and Focus Mode gates.
entries.newApproach: Fresh-room runs write generalized receipts to docs/eval/fresh-room/<case-id>/latest.json and pass scripts/fresh-room-proof-verify.ts.
